rupees_per_ha.source: A: recoverable property tax per ha of newly detected built-up = Rs 14,000/property/yr (GBA finance-panel estimate Rs 700-1,000 cr/yr from ~5 lakh unassessed properties, low end) x 25 properties/ha (assumption, plotted layouts) x 0.24 share unassessed (5 of ~20.5 lakh). Sources: newsfirstprime.com (BBMP unassessed properties), deccanherald.com (BBMP FY24-25 Rs 4,930 cr). C: single conservative rate Rs 4,38,000/ha = LOWEST forest NPV rate in the Supreme Court 2008 order (T.N. Godavarman v UoI, IA 826; range Rs 4.38-10.43 lakh/ha by eco-class and density; later MoEFCC revisions are reported ~Rs 9.3-16.4 lakh/ha, secondary sources only), applied to hasdeo forest clearing and mine expansion (forestsclearance.nic.in NPV revision note 2021; wwfin.awsassets.panda.org/downloads/pocketful_of_forests.pdf; kalpavriksh.org KV_CAMPA_Revised_Final.pdf, 2022). Sand cross-check (not used, lower-bound only): Bihar price cap Rs 9/cft in 2021 (Hindustan Times, pressreader.com 2021-09-23) = ~Rs 318/m3; Sand (others) royalty 30% ad valorem in Bihar Minerals Rules 2019 (legitquest.com; snippet, rate for river sand unconfirmed) = ~Rs 95/m3; 1 ha pit x 2 m depth (assumed) = 20,000 m3 = ~Rs 19 lakh/ha, above the NPV floor, so one rate is conservative for both. Bihar loss claim 'Rs 600-700 crore/yr' is a minister statement reported by SANDRP (sandrp.in/2020/07/22, 2020), NOT a CAG figure; CAG 2020 audit found Rs 166.98 crore lost on unsettled ghats in 5 of 14 districts. UNEP 2019 'Sand and sustainability' was not fetched, so it is not used. Assumption: value per hectare of VERIFIED leads (audit precision in reports/audit_trackc.json is low for sand), rates are not a measured recovery.

level_fraction.source: PRD s8: packet ~70% of decision value; thumb/full are modeled, not measured.

level_bytes.source: HANDOFF: packet 256 B, thumb 2400 B; full = measured zlib(level 6) size of the chip (proxy for CCSDS-122), cumulative sizes.

half_life_h.source: Freshness half-life of an alert; modeled.

pull_threshold.source: H2 pulls the full chip only if tile value >= this many rupees; modeled.

rupees_per_contact_min.source: Editable ground-station cost per contact minute; placeholder.
